traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets power and intensity. A magnetic, high-voltage presence that others react to immediately. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Strength and depth, well-controlled. A natural aptitude for investigation, healing, and transformation. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize selfhood and power into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what selfhood and power have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: You may finally get the conversation you have been rehearsing in your head for months, so do not waste it proving how angry you had every right to be.
readerCopy.body: You may finally get the conversation you have been rehearsing in your head for months, so do not waste it proving how angry you had every right to be. When the Sun sextiles Pluto, confidence and leverage can come together in a way that gives you access to the person, decision, boundary, or resource capable of changing something that has felt stuck. That opening is more valuable than the satisfaction of unloading every grievance that led you there. Say enough to establish the problem, then ask for the change that would actually alter what happens next.
